title: mw.txn.action.v1
description: An operator action on one transaction, approved by maker-checker in mw-admin-api (spec 15.2, 15.3, ticket 37), for mw-orchestrator: INQUIRE runs one status inquiry now (UNKNOWN or MANUAL_REVIEW; the answer goes on the saga timeline, in MANUAL_REVIEW it changes nothing), FORCE_COMMIT / FORCE_RELEASE leave MANUAL_REVIEW for COMMITTING / RELEASING (spec 7.2). Reversal is not an action here: it is a REVERSAL on mw.txn.request.v1 (channel SYSTEM). Applied once per actionId; an action the transaction's state or flow does not allow changes nothing and is audited as refused. Key: txnId. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

actionId.description: Unique per action; the consumer's dedup key.

checkerId.description: Operator who approved; never the maker.
